summary: Marwynn Holdings filed an 8-K on October 9, 2026, disclosing an October 8 memorandum of understanding with Singapore's OmniX Technologies to evaluate AI and high-performance computing, RWA/securities infrastructure, and regional distribution cooperation. The MOU is non-binding as to investment or acquisition, though it designates each party preferred supplier/provider in defined licensed territories via binding process provisions. No price, stake, premium, advisor, or timeline is stated. The filing reflects exploratory commercial partnering rather than a special situation; watch for any definitive agreement or strategic investment that would elevate it.
